title: Codex Collection opens
summary: The Bible Scroll is now Codex Collection: a growing library of ancient writings, translated into clear modern English from the original languages, with the evidence and context to explore them yourself. This first release brings 22 books of the Bible, from Genesis to Revelation, plus four writings from beyond the 66.

items.text: The Law (Torah): Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers and Deuteronomy.
History: Joshua, Judges, Ruth, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, Ezra, Nehemiah and Esther.
Poetry and Wisdom: Job, Psalms and Proverbs.
Hebrews and the General Letters: Jude.
431 topic pages, each gathering one subject from across the collection.
A new home page, a page for all the scrolls, articles, release notes, and a page explaining our mission and how the collection is made.
